plan.notes: Term-by-term sequence transcribed verbatim from the official 2024-2025 American International College 'Program Plan' for Liberal Studies (School of Business, Arts and Sciences). Semester totals printed on the plan: 15+16+15+15+15+14+15+15 = 120 credits (TOTAL CREDITS: 120). The program is a Bachelor of Arts (standard for AIC liberal arts programs; the plan does not print a degree abbreviation). Students choose TWO concentration areas approved by the Dean of Business, Arts and Sciences: Concentration Area 1 = 12 credits (4 courses) at the 2000/3000/4000 level; Concentration Area 2 = 18 credits (6 courses) at the 2000/3000/4000 level. Traditional liberal arts areas include Biology, Chemistry, Economics, English, History, Mathematics (not MAT1430 or MAT2030), Philosophy, Physics, Political Science, Psychology, and Sociology. The ten 'Concentration area course' slots in the sequence (2+1+2+2+2+1 across Sophomore-Senior years) fulfill the 30-credit concentration requirement. Major requirements: COM1282 Media Literacy, ENG2213 Public Speaking, SOC2420 Sociology of American Institutions, ENG4700 Senior Writing Capstone; choose HST3100 Coming to America OR ENG3200 Topics in Literature; choose an American Literature course (ENG2430, ENG3400, or ENG3410); Senior Spring requires any internship course (XXX4899) or any research experience (XXX48xx). General Education categories per the 2024-2025 plan: Cat 1 Scientific World (math + science with lab), Cat 2 Self and Others, Cat 3 Interdisciplinarity (ENG1202 + INT courses; COM1282 counts as Gen Ed Cat 3), Cat 4 Arts and Humanities, Cat 5 Professional Readiness (AIC1005/AIC1100 + AIC3005). tccns mirrors the local course code (AIC is in Massachusetts; no TCCNS). transfer_confidence is 'core_only'.
